headline: 5 students injured in Demra madrasa explosion
summary: Students were hurt by falling bricks after a blast occurred at a madrasa in Dhaka's Demra area.
details: Five students were injured after an explosion occurred at a madrasa in the Demra area of Dhaka.
The blast caused bricks to fall on the students while they were sleeping, leading to their injuries.
The injured students were immediately rushed to the hospital for medical treatment.
Authorities are investigating the cause of the explosion that occurred within the educational institution.

headline: Tuesday: 4-hour power outage in several areas
summary: Scheduled maintenance work will lead to electricity disruptions across various locations this Tuesday.
details: Several areas will face a continuous 4-hour power outage this Tuesday due to scheduled maintenance work.
The power cuts are planned to ensure the stability and efficiency of the electricity grid in the affected regions.
Residents in the specified areas are advised to make necessary preparations for the temporary disruption of power supply.
Authorities have announced the schedule to allow citizens to plan their daily activities accordingly.
